summary.headline: 今日雷达主线：GitHub 热门继续围绕 Agent 工作流、个人云和文档/设计上下文扩散；搜广推从单模型优化转向召回、排序、serving 成本和实验血缘协同；A 社把 Claude 推向团队频道、长任务执行和安全治理。
bullets: GitHub 本轮由 google-labs-code/design.md、calesthio/OpenMontage、xbtlin/ai-berkshire 领跑；解读重点落在 设计系统上下文规范 / Agent 可读品牌资产、Agentic 视频生产 / 多工具创作流水线、Claude Code 投研 Agent / 价值投资研究框架、自托管协同旅行规划 / 个人云产品，采用判断不按 star 排序，而按架构机制、适用团队、落地路径、生产风险、决策问题和观察信号拆解。
开源项目解读已按“架构机制 -> 适用团队 -> 落地路径 -> 生产风险 -> 决策问题 -> 观察信号”展开；本轮更适合旁路 spike 的入口是：进入观察/试点池：为一个内部产品或设计系统生成 DESIGN.md，再让 Agent 改一个小页面对比前后风格一致性；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。

搜广推收录 28 条工程/研究信号，覆盖 Meta Engineering、Google Research、Pinterest Engineering、Spotify Engineering、Dropbox Tech、Alibaba Cloud Developer、Amazon Science、Netflix TechBlog、Airbnb Engineering、Meituan Tech、Salesforce Engineering、Tencent Cloud Developer；重点从「SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems」延伸到广告排序、实时上下文、企业搜索 relevance judge、模型生命周期图和工业搜索属性推荐。

A 社覆盖 18 条官方 News/Research/Engineering 动态，新增重点是「Introducing Claude Tag」；Claude Code 相关信号包括 Introducing Claude Tag、Agentic coding and persistent returns to expertise、Higher usage limits for Claude and a compute deal with SpaceX，评估动作应拆成模型能力、权限隔离、长任务恢复、团队协作记忆、预算上限和审计边界。
AIHOT/官方 AI 新闻共 36 条，其中 AIHOT 8 条；今日先看「OLMo Hybrid vs Transformer：混合模型在实义词上优势明显，但重复短语上几无优势」，所有新闻统一写成“信号 -> 影响 -> 动作”，动作聚焦评测回放、预算治理、工具白名单、权限审计和真实工作流验证。

analysis.oneLiner: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.；关键看 DESIGN.md 规范、YAML tokens、Markdown 设计原则、组件/语义约束和 Agent 可持久读取的设计系统文件 是否能被小范围验证。
analysis.whyItMatters: google-labs-code/design.md 处在 快速扩散项目 区间：18.6K stars / 1.6K forks，近期仍在活跃迭代。README 把重点放在「DESIGN.md」，适合判断它是否能在 产品界面交付、组件复用或交互体验一致性 上形成真实工程收益。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：DESIGN.md 规范、YAML tokens、Markdown 设计原则、组件/语义约束和 Agent 可持久读取的设计系统文件 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: TypeScript · Node 包/前端工程。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「Coding Agent 生成界面时缺少稳定的品牌、视觉 token、组件语义和设计原则上下文，导致每次输出风格漂移」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：DESIGN.md 规范、YAML tokens、Markdown 设计原则、组件/语义约束和 Agent 可持久读取的设计系统文件；阅读时把 TypeScript 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：有明确品牌规范、组件库和 AI 前端生成需求的设计工程/产品工程团队
落地路径：为一个内部产品或设计系统生成 DESIGN.md，再让 Agent 改一个小页面对比前后风格一致性；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。
生产风险：DESIGN.md 一旦陈旧会把过期视觉规范传播给 Agent，必须建立从设计源到代码仓库的同步责任。
决策问题：它解决的是「Coding Agent 生成界面时缺少稳定的品牌、视觉 token、组件语义和设计原则上下文，导致每次输出风格漂移」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
观察信号：token 命中率、设计 review 返工率、组件复用率、视觉漂移问题数、文档更新成本、最近 release 质量、issue 响应速度和 Node 包/前端工程 的集成反馈。
valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「Coding Agent 生成界面时缺少稳定的品牌、视觉 token、组件语义和设计原则上下文，导致每次输出风格漂移」，google-labs-code/design.md 的收益应体现为 token 命中率、设计 review 返工率、组件复用率、视觉漂移问题数、文档更新成本 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 设计系统尚未沉淀、token 来源不统一或希望用文档替代设计 review，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。
technicalTakeaways: 先抓 先看 front matter schema、token 粒度、语义规则、组件示例和与现有 design token 源的同步方式，再决定 spike 范围。
图解字段应突出 DESIGN.md 规范、YAML tokens、Markdown 设计原则、组件/语义约束和 Agent 可持久读取的设计系统文件 如何把 Coding Agent 生成界面时缺少稳定的品牌、视觉 token、组件语义和设计原则上下文，导致每次输出风格漂移 转成 把设计系统从人工解释转成机器可读上下文，提高 AI 生成界面的品牌一致性和可维护性。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: DESIGN.md A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system. The Format A DESIGN.md file combines machine readable design tokens (YAML front matter) with human readable design rationale (markdown prose). Tokens give agents exact values. Prose tells them why those values exist and how to apply them. An agent that reads this file will produce a UI with deep ink headlines in Public Sans, a warm limestone background, and Boston Clay call to action buttons. Getting Started Validate a DESIGN.md against the spec, catch broken token references, check WCAG contrast ratios, and surface structural findings — all as structured JSON that agents can act on. analysis.whyItMatters: xbtlin/ai-berkshire 值得看，是因为 AI 项目真正的分水岭已经从“能跑 demo”转向“能被治理、能接工具、能失败恢复”。当前 1.7K stars / 283 forks，维护非常活跃，足够进入 Agent 工程雷达。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：多 Agent 并行研究、价值投资 rubric、资料抓取/整理、交叉质询、投资备忘录和 Claude Code 工作流 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。

analysis.oneLiner: A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, interactive maps, PWA support, SSO, budgets, packing lists, and more.；关键看 自托管 Web/PWA、实时协作、交互地图、SSO、预算、packing list、行程对象模型和权限控制 是否能被小范围验证。
analysis.whyItMatters: mauriceboe/TREK 的热度来自“可持续维护的公共资料面”：6.4K stars / 596 forks，维护非常活跃。README 把重点放在「What you get」，说明它的价值更多在分类、治理和更新节奏，而不是某个单点技术实现。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：自托管 Web/PWA、实时协作、交互地图、SSO、预算、packing list、行程对象模型和权限控制 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: TypeScript · 容器化部署。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「家庭、朋友或小团队旅行规划分散在表格、聊天、地图、预算和清单里，难以协同和复盘」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：自托管 Web/PWA、实时协作、交互地图、SSO、预算、packing list、行程对象模型和权限控制；阅读时把 TypeScript 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：自托管爱好者、家庭/小团队协同、旅行社区和需要私有化行程数据的组织
落地路径：先部署给一个非敏感旅行计划，验证多人编辑、移动端离线体验、地图成本和备份恢复；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。
生产风险：旅行数据涉及位置、时间和同行人隐私；地图 API 成本、实时协作冲突和备份恢复要先验证。
决策问题：它解决的是「家庭、朋友或小团队旅行规划分散在表格、聊天、地图、预算和清单里，难以协同和复盘」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
观察信号：多人编辑冲突率、移动端完成率、地图加载延迟、预算/清单使用率、备份恢复时间、最近 release 质量、issue 响应速度和 容器化部署 的集成反馈。
valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「家庭、朋友或小团队旅行规划分散在表格、聊天、地图、预算和清单里，难以协同和复盘」，mauriceboe/TREK 的收益应体现为 多人编辑冲突率、移动端完成率、地图加载延迟、预算/清单使用率、备份恢复时间 的改善。

若 需要企业级商旅审批、供应商预订整合或对地图/协同 SLA 要求很高的场景，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。
technicalTakeaways: 先抓 先看实时同步模型、地图 provider、SSO/权限、PWA 缓存、数据导出和容器部署路径，再决定 spike 范围。

analysis.oneLiner: A tool for creating and running Linux containers using lightweight virtual machines on a Mac. It is written in Swift, and optimized for Apple silicon. ；关键看 Swift CLI、轻量 Linux VM、OCI image pull/run、虚拟网络、卷挂载、进程生命周期和 macOS 权限边界 是否能被小范围验证。
analysis.whyItMatters: apple/container 处在 成熟热门项目 区间：43K stars / 1.3K forks，维护非常活跃。README 把重点放在「Get started」，适合判断它是否能在 构建、调试、交付或依赖管理的效率瓶颈 上形成真实工程收益。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：Swift CLI、轻量 Linux VM、OCI image pull/run、虚拟网络、卷挂载、进程生命周期和 macOS 权限边界 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: Swift · API/SDK 接入。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「Mac 开发者需要接近 Linux 的容器体验，但又希望利用轻量虚拟机隔离、OCI 镜像和 Apple Silicon 性能」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：Swift CLI、轻量 Linux VM、OCI image pull/run、虚拟网络、卷挂载、进程生命周期和 macOS 权限边界；阅读时把 Swift 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：以 Mac 为主力开发机、Linux 服务较多、愿意维护本地开发平台规范的工程团队
落地路径：把一个非核心 Linux 服务或 CLI 测试环境迁到本地容器，旁路对比 Docker Desktop/Colima 的启动、网络和文件性能；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。
生产风险：容器兼容性、虚拟网络、文件系统一致性和企业安全策略会决定它能否替代现有本地运行时。
决策问题：它解决的是「Mac 开发者需要接近 Linux 的容器体验，但又希望利用轻量虚拟机隔离、OCI 镜像和 Apple Silicon 性能」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
观察信号：冷启动时间、镜像兼容率、文件 I/O、网络连通率、资源占用、开发者回滚时间、最近 release 质量、issue 响应速度和 API/SDK 接入 的集成反馈。

适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 强依赖 Docker Desktop 插件生态、复杂 compose 编排或企业设备策略不允许虚拟化扩展，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。

图解字段应突出 Swift CLI、轻量 Linux VM、OCI image pull/run、虚拟网络、卷挂载、进程生命周期和 macOS 权限边界 如何把 Mac 开发者需要接近 Linux 的容器体验，但又希望利用轻量虚拟机隔离、OCI 镜像和 Apple Silicon 性能 转成 减少本地环境漂移，让 Apple Silicon 开发机更稳定地承载 Linux 构建、测试和调试任务。

How does one person ship like a team of twenty? Peter Steinberger built OpenClaw — 247K GitHub stars — essentially solo with AI agents. The revolution is here. A single builder with the right tooling can move faster than a traditional team. I'm Garry Tan, President & CEO of Y Combinator. I've worked with thousands of startups — Coinbase, Instacart, Rippling — when they were one or two people in a garage. Before YC, I was one of the first eng/PM/designers at Palantir, cofounded Posterous (sold to Twitter), and built Bookface, YC's internal social network. gstack is my answer. I've been building products for twenty years, and right now I'm shipping more product...

analysis.whyItMatters: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws 值得看，是因为 AI 项目真正的分水岭已经从“能跑 demo”转向“能被治理、能接工具、能失败恢复”。当前 1.1K stars / 110 forks，维护非常活跃，足够进入 Agent 工程雷达。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：AWS 支持的 MCP servers、skills、plugins、服务 API 封装、最小权限配置和面向云资源的 Agent 工具分发 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: Python · API/SDK 接入。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「企业想让 Agent 安全地理解和操作 AWS，但自建 MCP/skills 容易缺少权限边界、服务覆盖和官方维护承诺」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：AWS 支持的 MCP servers、skills、plugins、服务 API 封装、最小权限配置和面向云资源的 Agent 工具分发；阅读时把 Python 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。

analysis.whyItMatters: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills 值得看，是因为 AI 项目真正的分水岭已经从“能跑 demo”转向“能被治理、能接工具、能失败恢复”。当前 21K stars / 2.4K forks，维护非常活跃，足够进入 Agent 工程雷达。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：按安全域组织的技能文件、框架映射、检测/响应流程、工具提示边界和跨平台 Agent skill 标准 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。

适用团队：有成熟安全流程、人工复核机制和框架化知识资产的 SOC、DevSecOps 或红蓝队平台团队

决策问题：它解决的是「安全团队希望把 ATT&CK、NIST、ATLAS、D3FEND 等框架转成可被 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等 Agent 调用的结构化技能」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？

valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「安全团队希望把 ATT&CK、NIST、ATLAS、D3FEND 等框架转成可被 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等 Agent 调用的结构化技能」，mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills 的收益应体现为 误报降噪率、研判耗时、MITRE 映射准确率、人工复核通过率、越权/误操作次数 的改善。

analysis.oneLiner: CasaOS - A simple, easy-to-use, elegant open-source Personal Cloud system.；关键看 Web 控制台、应用商店、Docker/服务编排、存储与账号管理、家庭网络入口和轻量运维界面 是否能被小范围验证。
analysis.whyItMatters: IceWhaleTech/CasaOS 处在 成熟热门项目 区间：34.6K stars / 2K forks，需要确认近期维护强度。README 把重点放在「CasaOS Your Personal Cloud」，适合判断它是否能在 部署、弹性、监控或平台化运维复杂度 上形成真实工程收益。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：Web 控制台、应用商店、Docker/服务编排、存储与账号管理、家庭网络入口和轻量运维界面 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: Go · 容器化部署。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「个人和小团队想运行 NAS、媒体、备份、下载和家庭自动化服务，但容器、网络和存储配置门槛高」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：Web 控制台、应用商店、Docker/服务编排、存储与账号管理、家庭网络入口和轻量运维界面；阅读时把 Go 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：自托管爱好者、家庭服务器、小型工作室和需要低门槛私有云的场景
落地路径：先在家庭实验室或备用设备上部署非关键服务，验证备份、升级、权限和远程访问边界；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。
生产风险：个人云把数据、网络入口和第三方容器集中在一起，供应链、备份和公网暴露要先治理。
决策问题：它解决的是「个人和小团队想运行 NAS、媒体、备份、下载和家庭自动化服务，但容器、网络和存储配置门槛高」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？

valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「个人和小团队想运行 NAS、媒体、备份、下载和家庭自动化服务，但容器、网络和存储配置门槛高」，IceWhaleTech/CasaOS 的收益应体现为 应用安装成功率、升级失败率、备份恢复时间、资源占用、远程访问安全事件 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 需要企业级 SLA、多租户隔离、合规审计或无人值守生产环境，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。

analysis.oneLiner: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.；关键看索引/查询机制、数据一致性和嵌入式运行成本。
analysis.whyItMatters: opendatalab/MinerU 值得看，是因为 AI 项目真正的分水岭已经从“能跑 demo”转向“能被治理、能接工具、能失败恢复”。当前 69.3K stars / 5.9K forks，维护非常活跃，足够进入 Agent 工程雷达。 这次更新更值得关注的是其可迁移机制：版面分析、OCR/表格/公式解析、文档结构恢复、Markdown/JSON 输出和批处理管线 能否被拆成小样本验证，而不是把项目整体搬进生产。
analysis.engineeringRead: Python · 容器化部署。建议按“入口示例 -> 数据/配置 -> 失败处理 -> CI/release -> issue 反例”的顺序读；重点回答 它解决的是「PDF、Office 和复杂版面文档难以稳定转成可检索、可引用、可进入 RAG/Agent 的结构化数据」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？
architectureSignals: 架构机制：版面分析、OCR/表格/公式解析、文档结构恢复、Markdown/JSON 输出和批处理管线；阅读时把 Python 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：知识库、科研、法务、金融报告、教育资料和 Agent 文档处理平台团队
落地路径：选一批非敏感历史文档做离线解析评测，只进入只读 RAG 索引，不直接覆盖原始文档；先保留人工复核、指标记录和回滚路径。
生产风险：索引正确性、更新一致性、内存上限和崩溃恢复不能只靠 benchmark 判断。
决策问题：它解决的是「PDF、Office 和复杂版面文档难以稳定转成可检索、可引用、可进入 RAG/Agent 的结构化数据」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？

适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: 推荐系统需要在巨大候选池里兼顾兴趣匹配、新鲜度、多样性和商业目标，传统召回/排序割裂会造成离线提升难以上线转化。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把候选生成、向量/索引、用户序列、ranker 表征和反馈学习联合设计，让召回质量与后续排序目标保持一致。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 关注 recall@K、覆盖率、多样性、CTR/CVR、停留/满意度、延迟和索引刷新时延；实验要看离线召回是否转化为在线核心指标。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴模型化索引、可编辑生成式召回、多目标排序和实时行为特征，将推荐漏斗从组件拼接改为端到端协同。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、业务目标单一或团队没有检索/排序联合 owner 时，复杂联合建模会增加维护成本。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索和社区搜索的长尾查询、权限边界、语义漂移和标注稀缺会拉低相关性，人工标注又难以覆盖全部候选。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 通过混合检索、模型化相关性评估、LLM 辅助标注或自动化 judge，把查询理解、召回、排序和质量评估串成闭环。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 NDCG/MRR、answer match、人工一致性、长尾覆盖、权限误召、P95 延迟和标注成本；线上需要观察搜索成功率与二次查询率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合迁移到企业知识库、RAG、客服搜索和社区内容搜索：先建立可靠评测集，再让 LLM 扩大标注覆盖。
interpretation.boundary: 如果文档权限复杂但审计不足，或 LLM judge 没有金标校准，自动评估会把错误相关性放大到生产排序。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告候选、排序和竞价需要同时控制转化价值、用户体验、延迟与算力成本，单点模型提升很难直接证明业务收益。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户行为序列、实时上下文、候选生成、轻量排序、精排/重排和预算约束拆成可观测阶段，并在高价值候选上投入更重模型。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 优先看 CTR、CVR、CPA/ROAS、广告质量、P95 延迟、推理成本和预算消耗；在线实验要同时观察广告主价值与用户负反馈。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴分阶段候选裁剪、实时特征注入、模型容量自适应和在线/离线差异诊断，把算力预算变成排序策略的一部分。
interpretation.boundary: 流量小、转化回传慢、成本归因不清或缺少在线实验平台时，不适合直接复制大厂多阶段广告架构。

items.title: How we optimized Dash's relevance judge with DSPy
items.summary: Dropbox 用 DSPy 将搜索相关性 judge 的提示词优化变成可测量、可迁移的自动化循环，降低 LLM judge 脆弱性。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索和社区搜索的长尾查询、权限边界、语义漂移和标注稀缺会拉低相关性，人工标注又难以覆盖全部候选。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 通过混合检索、模型化相关性评估、LLM 辅助标注或自动化 judge，把查询理解、召回、排序和质量评估串成闭环。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 NDCG/MRR、answer match、人工一致性、长尾覆盖、权限误召、P95 延迟和标注成本；线上需要观察搜索成功率与二次查询率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合迁移到企业知识库、RAG、客服搜索和社区内容搜索：先建立可靠评测集，再让 LLM 扩大标注覆盖。
interpretation.boundary: 如果文档权限复杂但审计不足，或 LLM judge 没有金标校准，自动评估会把错误相关性放大到生产排序。

interpretation.boundary: 流量小、转化回传慢、成本归因不清或缺少在线实验平台时，不适合直接复制大厂多阶段广告架构。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.

items.title: PACMS: Submodular Context Selection as a Pluggable Engine for LLM Agents
items.summary: Conversational and tool-using LLM agents operate over a context window that fills from several directions simultaneously. As a session proceeds, the agent accumulates user and assistant turns, entries drawn from a persistent memory store, and often largest of all, the verbatim outputs of tool calls such as file reads, search results, and API responses. Once the cumulative context exceeds the model's token budget, the framework must decide what to keep. The prevailing mechanism is recency truncation, sometimes paired with periodic summarization. This is topic-blind: a fact established early in a session is discarded simply because it is old, even when the current user query is about exactly that fact; conversely, verbose but irrelevant recent material is retained. Agents that must recall information across many turns, the defining case for memory, are precisely where recency truncation fails. Existing alternatives sit outside the agent's assembly step. Retrieval augmented generation fetches external documents into the prompt but does not arbitrate the agent's \emph{already-present} pooled context. Context-compression methods reduce token count by rewriting or pruning text, but operate query-blind and lossily. Neither treats memory entries, conversation turns, and tool outputs as a single candidate pool to be selected from by relevance at the moment the prompt is assembled.

items.title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
items.summary: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints inherent to fixed-dimensional vectors. An emerging alternative for discrete user representation -- using LLMs to generate text-based user tokens -- captures topical co-occurrences rather than deep sequential behavior dynamics and produces outputs that are difficult to ground to item attributes. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) based item tokenization has proven effective for improving generalization in generative recommendation, yet discrete SID-based representations for users remain largely unexplored. We propose TokenMinds, an industrial-scale system that extends the PLUM framework from item retrieval to user modeling, generating both discrete SID-based user tokens and dense user embeddings via an encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pre-trained LLMs. This dual-output design provides the complementary benefits of discrete, semantically grounded user representations while maintaining compatibility with existing downstream models that rely on dense embeddings. Additionally, the shared SID vocabulary naturally extends to cross-scenario modeling: by unifying long-form and short-form video behaviors into a single model, we substantially reduce training and serving costs. We validate TokenMinds through extensive offline experiments and live launches on multiple YouTube surfaces, served on full user traffic (billions of users) via an asynchronous infrastructure that decouples representation generation from downstream scoring. Focusing on ranking as the primary downstream use case, our results confirm the practical viability of SID-based user tokens at industrial scale and demonstrate that tokens and dense embeddings provide complementary value across different production ranking systems.

selected.title: OLMo Hybrid vs Transformer：混合模型在实义词上优势明显，但重复短语上几无优势
selected.summary: 通过对比7B参数的OLMo 3（Transformer）与OLMo Hybrid（混合架构），实验发现混合模型在大多数token上预测损失更低：对名词、动词、形容词等实义词优势明显（loss gap约0.04），功能词上gap约0.02，且在需上下文推理的代词指代上更好。但在重复出现的n-gram和闭合括号（如`}`）上，混合模型的优势几乎消失，Transformer凭借注意力机制更擅长从输入中直接检索精确信息。

items.title: Meta员工警告AI内容审核部署过快
items.summary: Meta在2025年已用大语言模型替换约一半人工审核请求，计划年底前将部分内容类型的AI审核比例提升至90%以上，每年节省数十亿美元。Meta否认成本动机，称自3月测试显示其模型错误率比人类低13%，且多捕捉10%违规。但员工指出模型仍会移除或限流无害内容，缺乏足够监督，快速部署已导致外包裁员。此外，Meta已从使用Google Gemini转向自家新基础模型Muse Spark，该模型基于人工审核员的历史决策训练。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: 推荐系统需要在巨大候选池里兼顾兴趣匹配、新鲜度、多样性和商业目标，传统召回/排序割裂会造成离线提升难以上线转化。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把候选生成、向量/索引、用户序列、ranker 表征和反馈学习联合设计，让召回质量与后续排序目标保持一致。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 关注 recall@K、覆盖率、多样性、CTR/CVR、停留/满意度、延迟和索引刷新时延；实验要看离线召回是否转化为在线核心指标。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴模型化索引、可编辑生成式召回、多目标排序和实时行为特征，将推荐漏斗从组件拼接改为端到端协同。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、业务目标单一或团队没有检索/排序联合 owner 时，复杂联合建模会增加维护成本。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索和社区搜索的长尾查询、权限边界、语义漂移和标注稀缺会拉低相关性，人工标注又难以覆盖全部候选。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 通过混合检索、模型化相关性评估、LLM 辅助标注或自动化 judge，把查询理解、召回、排序和质量评估串成闭环。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 NDCG/MRR、answer match、人工一致性、长尾覆盖、权限误召、P95 延迟和标注成本；线上需要观察搜索成功率与二次查询率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合迁移到企业知识库、RAG、客服搜索和社区内容搜索：先建立可靠评测集，再让 LLM 扩大标注覆盖。
interpretation.boundary: 如果文档权限复杂但审计不足，或 LLM judge 没有金标校准，自动评估会把错误相关性放大到生产排序。

interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户行为序列、实时上下文、候选生成、轻量排序、精排/重排和预算约束拆成可观测阶段，并在高价值候选上投入更重模型。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.

items.title: PACMS: Submodular Context Selection as a Pluggable Engine for LLM Agents
items.summary: Conversational and tool-using LLM agents operate over a context window that fills from several directions simultaneously. As a session proceeds, the agent accumulates user and assistant turns, entries drawn from a persistent memory store, and often largest of all, the verbatim outputs of tool calls such as file reads, search results, and API responses. Once the cumulative context exceeds the model's token budget, the framework must decide what to keep. The prevailing mechanism is recency truncation, sometimes paired with periodic summarization. This is topic-blind: a fact established early in a session is discarded simply because it is old, even when the current user query is about exactly that fact; conversely, verbose but irrelevant recent material is retained. Agents that must recall information across many turns, the defining case for memory, are precisely where recency truncation fails. Existing alternatives sit outside the agent's assembly step. Retrieval augmented generation fetches external documents into the prompt but does not arbitrate the agent's \emph{already-present} pooled context. Context-compression methods reduce token count by rewriting or pruning text, but operate query-blind and lossily. Neither treats memory entries, conversation turns, and tool outputs as a single candidate pool to be selected from by relevance at the moment the prompt is assembled.

items.title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
items.summary: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints inherent to fixed-dimensional vectors. An emerging alternative for discrete user representation -- using LLMs to generate text-based user tokens -- captures topical co-occurrences rather than deep sequential behavior dynamics and produces outputs that are difficult to ground to item attributes. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) based item tokenization has proven effective for improving generalization in generative recommendation, yet discrete SID-based representations for users remain largely unexplored. We propose TokenMinds, an industrial-scale system that extends the PLUM framework from item retrieval to user modeling, generating both discrete SID-based user tokens and dense user embeddings via an encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pre-trained LLMs. This dual-output design provides the complementary benefits of discrete, semantically grounded user representations while maintaining compatibility with existing downstream models that rely on dense embeddings. Additionally, the shared SID vocabulary naturally extends to cross-scenario modeling: by unifying long-form and short-form video behaviors into a single model, we substantially reduce training and serving costs. We validate TokenMinds through extensive offline experiments and live launches on multiple YouTube surfaces, served on full user traffic (billions of users) via an asynchronous infrastructure that decouples representation generation from downstream scoring. Focusing on ranking as the primary downstream use case, our results confirm the practical viability of SID-based user tokens at industrial scale and demonstrate that tokens and dense embeddings provide complementary value across different production ranking systems.

nodes.detail: 把候选生成、向量/索引、用户序列、ranker 表征和反馈学习联合设计，让召回质量与后续排序目标保持一致。

nodes.label: 指标实验
nodes.detail: 关注 recall@K、覆盖率、多样性、CTR/CVR、停留/满意度、延迟和索引刷新时延；实验要看离线召回是否转化为在线核心指标。

nodes.label: 采用边界
nodes.detail: 物料规模不大、业务目标单一或团队没有检索/排序联合 owner 时，复杂联合建模会增加维护成本。
